title: Outdoor gear (Turkish name)
name: Göçebe
ask: Create a brand identity for Göçebe, the outdoor and travel gear shop in this folder.
owner: Owner preferences: durable, free-spirited and grounded, Turkish at heart but ready for Europe; for hikers and long-distance travellers. The wordmark must keep the Turkish letters ö and ç correct. No mountains, tents, compasses, trees or arrows. Web shop, product tags, social, and an embroidered or woven label version.
